title: Report Claims and Verification Sidecar Schema
description: Authoritative contract for versioned report claims sidecar (report-claims.json). Captures bidirectional mappings between report text spans and evidence ledger claims, snapshot bindings, cryptographic digests, and independent evaluator review decisions.

report_path.description: Relative POSIX-style path from workspace root to the target rendered report markdown file.

report_digest.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest of the exact UTF-8 byte content of the report file.

algorithm.description: Identifier and version of the extraction and span-resolution algorithm.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this sidecar was extracted and compiled.

commit.description: Git commit SHA of the generator implementation.

metadata.description: Optional metadata including research question, workspace identifier, or run options.

spans.description: Ordered collection of discrete text spans parsed from narrative, tables, captions, and footnotes.

span_id.description: Unique stable identifier for this text span within the report sidecar.

start_offset.description: 0-based character start offset in the UTF-8 decoded report document.

end_offset.description: 0-based character end offset (exclusive) in the UTF-8 decoded report document.

line_number.description: 1-based starting line number in the source markdown report for diagnostic tracing.

text.description: Verbatim text string extracted between start_offset and end_offset.

location_type.description: Document structural element containing this span.

statement_type.description: Epistemic classification: factual assertions require evidence binding; inferences require disclosure; non_factual/instructional must be verified structurally.

claim_ids.description: Ledger claim identifiers referenced by or associated with this span. Must be non-empty if statement_type is factual.

is_compound_claim.description: True if span contains multiple distinct factual assertions requiring multi-clause decomposition.

sub_clauses.description: Decomposed sub-clauses when is_compound_claim is true.

evidence_bindings.description: Collection of cryptographic and snapshot bindings anchoring this span's claims to underlying evidence.

claim_id.description: Target claim identifier in the evidence ledger.

source_url.description: Source canonical URI or local file URI.

snapshot_digest.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest of the raw snapshot artifact.

snapshot_path.description: Relative workspace path to the immutable snapshot file on disk.

snapshot_offsets.description: Byte or character offsets inside snapshot where verbatim quote is anchored.

quote.description: Exact excerpt from the source snapshot supporting the assertion.

support_status.description: Classification result produced by the evaluator verification engine.

verification_method.description: Mechanism used to verify adherence of quote to snapshot and claim to quote.

reason_codes.description: Diagnostic codes emitted during classification (e.g. NUMBER_MISMATCH, NEGATION_INVERTED).

uncovered_factual_spans_count.description: Number of factual spans in report that have no valid claim/evidence binding. Must be 0 for verified status.

unsupported_claims_count.description: Number of claims whose evidence binding failed verification. Must be 0 for verified status.

requires_review_count.description: Number of spans requiring secondary human or oracle adjudication.

reasons.description: Structured explanation of non-zero rejection or review flags.

reviewer.description: Independent reviewer identity, isolated from the authoring agent.

assurance_tier.description: Final assurance tier granted to the report artifact.
